ops.title: ptyrelay teardown semantics: review-proven decisions (v0.56 ccp-add UX train)
ops.body:
Decisions from the 2026-07-15 finder/refuter review of the ccp-add PTY-relay UX change, each verified against terminal standards or live probes. Read before changing ptyrelay teardown, kitty/SGR tracking, or ^C handling.

- Kitty keyboard stacks are PER-SCREEN (main vs alternate): ResetSeq pops alt-screen pushes BEFORE `?1049l` and main-screen pushes after. Blind double-pop was rejected — the main stack can hold real entries. Alt-stack residue left after the child itself exits the alt screen is deliberately untouched (popping it from the main screen would corrupt the main stack).
- A child killed mid-escape leaves the REAL terminal mid-parse: teardown emits an abort prefix first — ST (\x1b\\) for OSC/DCS/SOS/PM/APC, CAN (0x18) for ESC/CSI (VT100/ECMA-48; honored by xterm/iTerm2/VTE). Scanner also treats CAN/SUB as sequence aborts while parsing.
- darwin pty: the master fd is NOT poller-registered (no read deadlines; Close doesn't unblock reads). The output pump's defined exit is master EOF after the child is reaped — XNU revokes the controlling tty when the session leader exits (REVOKEALL), so a grandchild inheriting the slave cannot wedge Wait. Live-probed on this machine AND source-confirmed vs XNU kern_exit.c during review.
- Raw-mode host stdin gets ISIG re-enabled with only INTR live (VQUIT/VSUSP/VDSUSP disabled = 0xff): ^C interrupts ccp (whose watch loop then closes claude and unwinds the add via the awaitCanceled path — no stray name prompt), while ^\/^Z stay plain bytes so no signal can kill/stop ccp and strand a raw tty.
- The clipboard note prints ONLY after teardown (never injected into the live stream): claude's ink UI repaints with relative cursor motion, so any in-band injected line gets overdrawn/displaced. The URL is still copied the moment it appears (OnURL runs on its own goroutine; pbcopy bounded to 2s so Wait's join is bounded).
- SGR tracking stays coarse (any non-reset SGR = dirty -> one trailing SGR0): a "last param 0 clears" refinement was rejected because 38;2;R;G;B ends in params that can be 0 while leaving color active; exact tracking needs 38/48/58 group parsing and isn't worth it (trailing SGR0 is benign; pre-relay code emitted it unconditionally).
- Hyphenated org email labels merge base segments: orgLabelWithSuffix drops local tokens equal to ANY hyphen-segment of the org base (e-corp-claude-10@e-corp.com -> E-Corp-10, not E-Corp-E-Corp-10).
